summary: Comprehensive implementation plan to refactor UniSphere's UI to a warm, minimalist Slite-inspired aesthetic (warm cream #fdf9f4 canvas, white/dust cream #f9efe4 surfaces, charcoal #2d2f34 headings, ember orange #f67748 accent, hairline silver #ecedef borders, and pill buttons/dust chips) while preserving all React logic, Firebase Firestore synchronization, and compact data-dense features.
